dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Please wait, dear customer... Ah, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: What is your business in Komore Teahouse today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are still as cautious as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Komore Teahouse has the best view among all the high-end tea houses on this street. Many customers come here on its account.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: But of course, there are some guests who come here for our owner. They don't really drink tea, but they do want to see Taroumaru, which is troubling...

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: They just barge in here without knowing the first thing about this place. Their bravery is indeed commendable, but I wouldn't make much of anything else about them.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Only the guests who are approved by me may enter. As for the rest of the riffraff, I shall politely ask them to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here to play with Taroumaru.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Ah... even you...

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: If it were just some ordinary guest, I wouldn't have allowed it. Is Taroumaru some mongrel by the road, that they may pet him without even buying some tea first?

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Taroumaru is the owner of Komore Teahouse. Every staff member working here has signed a contract with it, and are to remain trapped here to work forever, unable to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Therefore, though I can make an exception to let you interact with Taroumaru, I recommend that you watch yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: ...Eh? You are looking forward to signing a contract with Taroumaru? Well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I hope that you will have a safe journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Politely, you say.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Yes. Do you have any doubts about that?

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: As the hostess of a high-end tea house and the retainer of the Kamisato Clan, being understanding is a necessary virtue.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Even if the guest is not an upstanding person, I will still treat them with respect... as long as they know how to be respectful in turn.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There appears to be an odd person in the courtyard.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Ah, as expected. You noticed as well?

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: There is no need to worry. That "young and capable individual" with "friends from many lands" with "profound knowledge" and "surprisingly great taste in tea" is already under my surveillance. There will not be any problems.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: My apologies, but Komore Teahouse does not just serve anyone. Please leave.
